My name is Ryan “Big Sarge” Hoffman, I served in the Army for 22 years in all leadership roles from a squad leader to battalion master trainer. I joined the Army in 2000 at the age of 18 after I graduated from high school. I married my wife in 2005 and we had two awesome girls named Harper and Harlow. I’ve had the opportunity to travel all across the United States and the world. After 22 years in the Army, I was looking for a career that would keep me in the same environment with Veterans that I had become accustomed to. We speak the same language, we hold the same values, and we answer the same call to action. Joining the “A Veterans Pool Company” franchise allows me to create a future for myself and my family. It also allows me the opportunity to work alongside those that march to the same beat. I am looking forward to a new career that has endless opportunities and allows me to be engaged in the community. I have an extreme passion for high standards and achieving the best results that I can. I hope to carry the standards that I was taught from the Army into my next profession as a pool renovator. reviews.text: My wife and I are very happy that we chose Ryan "Big Sarge"  Hoffman and A Veteran's Pool Company for our pool reno in Rockwall. Ryan exemplifies the characteristics of honor, honesty and and integrity, traits that aren't universal in the pool business. Our project came out better (and was completed sooner) than we could have hoped; Ryan kept us informed every step of the way and there were no surprises. There were no "problems", only solutions. Ryan strives for 5 Star Service, and he earned all 5 on this project. I can highly recommend Big Sarge and A Veteran's Pool Company. Thanks, Ryan!
reviews.author: Kevin Light

reviews.text: Total transformation of our pool! My wife and I researched quite a bit before we made our choice- and I am glad we chose Ryan. The communication and attention to detail are second to none! He was very conscious of our budget- not trying to up sell us on unnecessary upgrades. He truly cares about the work he does- and it shows. If you need any pool remodeling- do yourself a favor- and give Big Sarge a shout!!! You will be glad you did. This is gonna be the best Summer ever. Thank you Ryan!!!
reviews.author: wade losee

reviews.text: I had met with Ryan to discuss replacing the coping on my pool as well as re-plastering the pool as well.  My project was handled in a professional manner and was completed ahead of time.  I made a couple of changes to my request after our initial acceptance meeting, he made the changes and Ryan and his staff did an OUTSTANDING job on my pool.  Project came in on budget and was done in a timely manner.  The after care on my pool was excellent and I am extremely happy with the results!  Thank you for all your hard work!!
reviews.author: Jon Robbins

reviews.text: Ryan Hoffman and his crew did an amazing job on our 25 year old pool.  We needed repairs and new plaster.  Ryan and his crew made my pool look new.  I was contacted daily with updates.  I would highly recommend A Veteran Pool Company and Ryan to anyone needing an update or repairs on their pool.
reviews.author: Susie Miller

reviews.text:
It's not very often that you get the chance to meet True Professionals in any industry, let alone the service industry but that all changed when I met with Ryan Hoffman of A Veteran's Pool Company in Wylie. My wife and I didn't even know where to start with getting some repairs/remodeling done to our pool, saw the reviews and gave it a shot. Ryan handled everything like a True Pro! Timing for multiple estimates (for different options) was impeccable! Pricing was beyond fair (some other quotes we've had were much higher for less work and much lower (with fewer guarantees.) I feel as though A Veteran's Pool Company comes with the integrity and respect you would expect from our nations finest (Military.)
While he was on site for the estimates and options, he noticed my pump seemed to be struggling, politely asked to take a look, then made a slight adjustment and it's been running perfectly ever since! I tried to pay him for the repair to which he refused, told me it's worth saving it now vs having to buy a new one! I am still in awe of my encounters with Ryan ... He has proven that choosing his company is the best decision a pool owner can make! Thank you for this experience and thank you for your service!
reviews.author: Baby Yoda 2

reviews.text:
Ryan has to be the best contractor I’ve ever hired. From the start, he was punctual and communicative. We weren’t really sure how to approach resurfacing our pool, but Ryan guided us through every step of the process with absolute professionalism and kindness.

There was no pushy salesmanship or anything of that nature. He even steered us away from a more expensive tile because he could tell it wouldn’t give us the effect we were describing.

Something that stood out about Ryan was his willingness to go the extra mile to make sure we were happy with our finished product. He encouraged us to inspect the work during construction each day, and to speak up throughout the process if we wanted something fixed or done differently. When we did speak up about one arrangement of trim tiles that had already been laid, he made us feel completely comfortable. He immediately made the change that we were looking for, then followed up again to make sure it was perfect.

To be honest, I’m a little late writing this review. It’s been about 9 months since our pool project was complete. However, he stopped by this week to follow up and make sure everything was still up to par for us! I even noticed he cleaned out our baskets for us while he was here. I mean, who does that??? He goes above and beyond every step of the way.

Obviously, the pool is absolutely stunning. It blew our expectations out of the water. But the real standout is this business owner’s character.

Hire a veteran. Hire Ryan.
reviews.author: Halen Pruitt

reviews.text: Ryan "Big Sarge" Hoffman was a pleasure to work with throughout the entire project. I highly recommend him for your pool remodel. After receiving several quotes, Sarge was not only cheaper than competitors, but offered higher end products. The work was done within budget and within the scheduled time frame. Call around...but make sure you give Sarge a chance!
reviews.author: Ben Purvis

reviews.text: Ryan was amazing to work with.  He  takes professionalism and customer service to the next level.  We needed to replace the waterline tile and the mastic around the coping in our recently purchased home.  His communication and updates/status of the project was beyond excellent.  He was even able to coordinate the work to be performed while we were out of town so there was no down time for the pool for our family.  When we returned to the TX inferno after vacation, the pool was up and running.  Yay!  We will absolutely be reaching out to Ryan when we need to resurface the pool down the road.
reviews.author: Amanda Kosanda
